results.title: Named Atlantic storm tracks from 2025
results.sql:
SELECT sid, name, iso_time, latitude, longitude, wind_kts, pressure_mb
FROM atlantic_storms
WHERE season = 2025 AND name <> 'UNNAMED'
ORDER BY sid, iso_time
